visual.general_description: Grayscale transesophageal echocardiogram sector image on a black background with scale marks, a probe-angle icon and a bottom time bar.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale ultrasound sector with its apex at the top, filling most of the frame on a black background. Several large dark chamber-shaped regions are separated by thin bright linear echogenic structures; the grainy tissue at the bottom and sides of the sector is brighter. Yellow-green depth marks run along the left edge of the sector with the numerals 5 and 10, a small yellow-green V marker sits at the top of the sector, and a small yellow triangle marker sits at the left edge of the sector. In the upper right corner there is a small half-circle probe-angle icon with a green line and the numeral 0, a vertical gray-scale bar and a tiny corner icon. Along the bottom is a horizontal teal line with a vertical yellow-green bar at each end and a small red mark at its left end. No patient name, identifier, date or time is printed.

visual.general_description: Ultrasound image with a small 2D sector thumbnail, an M-mode trace with depth and time axes, dotted blue calipers and a printed measurement panel.
visual.detailed_description: Dark ultrasound screen. A blue-gray measurement panel at the upper left prints six rows: LVIDs 5.3 cm, ESV(Teich) 138 ml, EF(Teich) 20 %, %FS 9 %, LVIDd 5.9 cm and EDV(Teich) 172 ml, with a small green numeral 2 beside the LVIDs row and a small blue numeral 1 beside the LVIDd row. At the top center is a small 2D sector thumbnail with a yellow-green V marker and depth numerals 5 and 10. The upper right has a half-circle probe-angle icon with a green line, a vertical gray-scale bar and a tiny corner icon. Below the thumbnail is a wide M-mode trace of repeating bright and dark horizontal bands with a depth axis printed [cm] at the right with ticks 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 and 14, and a time axis at the bottom with ticks -4, -3, -2, -1 and 0 and the small text 50 mm/s. Two vertical dotted blue caliper lines with cross markers at their ends span the dark band of the trace, and a teal line runs along the bottom edge of the trace with a small red mark at its right end. No patient name, identifier, date or time is printed.
